contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ RVFVS.S.C ; R/ M N CORDIVS

A silver Denarius Roman Republican coin. Moneyer Mn. Cordius Rufus. Minted in Rome, 46BC, Reece period 1. Obverse shows Head of Venus right, wearing diadem. Obverse legend reads RVFVS.S.C . Reverse shows Cupid on dolphin right; bankers marks. Reverse legend reads M N CORDIVS. Condition is fair, die axis is 9 o'clock. Diameter is 19, weight is 3.29g
